issues.description: The template's ArrayHelpers class defines a method named appendElement(T[] array, T element) but Stock.java (in the template) calls ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...). This name/signature mismatch causes a compilation error and prevents students from building or running the project. The solution repository uses the name addElementToArray, matching Stock.java, so the template is inconsistent with both Stock.java and the provided solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the ArrayHelpers API consistent in the template. Either rename the method appendElement(...) in template_repository/src/.../ArrayHelpers.java to addElementToArray(...) (matching Stock.java and the solution), or change Stock.addToStockIngredients to call appendElement(...). The preferred fix is to rename appendElement to addElementToArray in the template so it matches the usage in Stock.java and the solution.

issues.description: The helper method for appending elements to arrays is named inconsistently across artifacts. In the template ArrayHelpers.java the method is declared as 'appendElement' but other template classes (e.g., Stock.java) call 'ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...)'. The solution code standardizes on 'addElementToArray'. This mismatch will cause compilation errors for students and creates unnecessary confusion about which ArrayHelpers method to use.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the method name across artifacts. Rename the method in template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/ArrayHelpers.java from 'appendElement' to 'addElementToArray' (matching usages in Stock.java and the solution), or alternatively update all call sites to use 'appendElement'. Prefer standardizing on 'addElementToArray' to match the solution and existing call sites.
